findings.problem: The Isaiah 44:6 verse milestone and seg hold only '‘Thus says the Lord, the King of Israel'. The rest of the verse ('and its redeemer, the Lord of Hosts: I am the first and I am the last and apart from Me there is no God’.') sits after the closing milestone, unscoped and merged with the connective 'And it was said:'. The Hebrew side has the whole verse in scope. The data is wrong (two segments: one scoped to the verse, one left unscoped), so the verse identity is wrongly bounded, the English and Hebrew are misaligned, and the connective text is mixed into quotation text. Compile pairing passes because it only matches corresp values.
findings.required_change: Fix the segmentation in the source data so the whole English verse, ending with ‘God’.’, is inside the isaiah_44_6 verse milestone/seg, and 'And it was said:' is a separate unscoped connective before Obadiah. Regenerate, then re-review this payload and the XML.

findings.problem: The payload marks the conditional fragment '(הַשַּׁבָּת וְ)' with join_next=true, but the next fragment starts with a space (' יִשְׂרָאֵל'). The generated XML has 'הַשַּׁבָּת וְ<j:endConditional/> יִשְׂרָאֵל', so the Shabbat profiles render 'וְ יִשְׂרָאֵל' with the prefix detached from its word. join_next is not honoured.
findings.required_change: Remove the leading space from the following fragment, or make the generator honour join_next, so it reads 'וְ<j:endConditional/>יִשְׂרָאֵל'. Check the Shabbat compiled outputs after regenerating.

findings.problem: The English translation carries <tei:milestone unit="half-verse" n="b" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:exodus/33/19/b"/>. JLPTEI-3.md ('Sub-verse scope') says half-verses are placed mechanically from the accents and that 'A translation has no accents and can place no half-verses'. The earlier 'Heye11 Ex33:19b partial quotation' approval may not have covered the English project.
findings.required_change: Remove the half-verse milestone/corresp from the English file. Keep the seg/source (and, if needed, the uncorresp'd chapter/verse milestones) so it still claims no full verse. Alternatively, get an explicit documented guideline exception.

findings.problem: Mixed identity layers: each chapter milestone carries a context URN (.../word_sources/numbers_28/quotes/numbers_28_9/numbers_28), but the verse milestone inside it carries the canonical urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:numbers/28/9 (and 28/10), so the verse URN is not a child of its enclosing chapter URN. The registry has no verse-level children for these quote contexts. The file is the target of the transclusions in musaf_repetition_sabbath_offerings.xml, so the canonical verse URNs are load-bearing.
findings.required_change: Make the layers consistent. Either use canonical urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:numbers/28 as the chapter corresp, if this file is the English project's single canonical home for these complete verses (and confirm 28/9-10 appear nowhere else in the English project), or use context URNs throughout and change the transclusion targets. Record the decision in the registry.

Each target has one realization-specific settings map, while attesting_controls lists other callers that print different wordings (rh_vetimlokh/he lists musaf_repetition_yimlokh at s226 and musaf_repetition_vetimlokh at s252 under s28 settings).
